profiles.name: Korobokuru
speciesTraits: A short, relatively lean dwarf relative, around 4 feet tall, with comparatively long limbs, pointed ears, and thick hair. The source places their communities in remote areas outside Rokugan.

Constitution +2, Intelligence −2. Small. Base land speed 20 ft. Apply size bonuses of +1 AC, +1 to attacks, and +4 Hide. Use appropriately sized weapons and three-quarters of Medium carrying capacity.
Darkvision to 60 ft. in black and white.
Racial +2 on saves against poison and on saves against spells and spell-like effects.
Racial +1 on attacks against goblinoids, including goblins, hobgoblins, bugbears, bakemono, and goblin rats.
Dodge bonus +4 to AC against giants. Lose it when circumstances deny the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Racial +2 on Wilderness Lore checks. Automatic languages Common and Dwarven. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Hengeyokai, and Sylvan. Favored class Barbarian.
The playable rules give 60-ft. darkvision. The published warrior encounter on pp. 171–172 lists 120 ft.

npcBuilds.name: Bramble

build.title: Korobokuru pass rescuer, Barbarian 1
traits: Leather armor. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 13. Base attack bonus +1. Face 5 by 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Add +4 dodge AC against giants while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
Fortitude +3, Reflex +1, Will −1. Add +2 on saves against poison and +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects. Add +1 to attacks against goblinoids.
Toughness adds 3 HP. Fast movement adds 10 ft. with light gear. Illiterate as a first-level Barbarian.

Rage once per day, up to 6 rounds. Str 17, Con 17, HP 13, AC 12, Fortitude +5, Will +1. Rage HP go away when it ends. Patient or concentration-dependent tasks such as spellcasting and moving silently are unavailable during rage.
After rage, fatigued for the rest of the encounter: Str 11, Dex 10, AC 13, Reflex +0. Cannot charge or run.
actions: Short sword. Melee +3, reach 5 ft., 1d6+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +5, 1d6+3. While fatigued +2, 1d6.
Thrown dagger. Ranged +3, 10-ft. range increment, 1d4+1 piercing, critical 19–20/×2. While raging +3, 1d4+3. While fatigued +2, 1d4.
build.tactics: Rig a safety line and get travelers off the exposed path. Stand between them and an attacker. Use rage if the evacuation is threatened. Withdraw once the last traveler reaches cover.

npcBuilds.role: Mountain-pass rescuer who can hold an evacuation route
npcBuilds.motive: Get a stranded repair crew off the pass before dark.
npcBuilds.hook: Bramble has a safety rope on the safe side but needs someone to reach the crew from the other bank.

profiles.name: Spirit Folk
speciesTraits: Humanlike descendants of nature spirits. Their source setting places them among communities near bamboo groves, rivers, or the sea, outside Rokugan.
Medium. Base land speed 30 ft. The shared traits give no ability score adjustments.
Low-light vision gives twice human viewing distance in dim light, with color and detail still visible.
Humanoid with the spirit subtype. Effects that target either spirits or humanoids can affect Spirit Folk.
Automatic languages Common and Spirit Tongue. Bonus languages Aquan, Giant, Goblin, Hengeyokai, and Nezumi. Favored class Any.
Bamboo lineage. Racial +2 Wilderness Lore and +4 Hide in woods or forests. Trackless Step leaves no trail in natural surroundings.
Racial +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects with earth, rock, stone, or wood in the name, earth shugenja spells, and wu jen spells tied to earth or wood.
Speak with animals once per day for one minute, as a 1st-level caster. This version can speak with any animal.

npcBuilds.name: Ilen

build.title: River Spirit Folk ferry healer, Adept 1
skills: Swim +7 for hazards or special actions
traits: River lineage. Breathes air and water. No routine swim check. Take 10 under pressure for Swim 17, and run while swimming in a straight line.
Unarmored. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 10. Base attack bonus +0. Fortitude +0, Reflex +1, Will +3.
Add +2 on saves against spells or spell-like effects with water in their names, water shugenja spells, and water-related wu jen spells.
Skill Focus (Heal) adds +2 in D&D 3.0. Prepared divine spells CL 1, DC 11 + spell level where applicable. Carries a divine focus.
actions: Club. Melee −1, reach 5 ft., 1d6−1 bludgeoning (minimum 1), critical ×2.
Prepared cantrips. Cure minor wounds twice per day, touch, restores 1 HP per cast. Create water once per day, creates up to two gallons of clean water.
Prepared 1st-level spells. Cure light wounds once per day, touch, restores 1d8+1 HP. Bless once per day, allies in a 50-ft. burst gain +1 morale to attack rolls and saves against fear for 1 minute.
River lineage. Speak with animals once per day for up to 1 minute, CL 1, fish only.
build.tactics: Move injured passengers behind cover, use healing on the worst injury, and use the river route when the landing is unsafe. Cast bless if allies need to hold the crossing.

npcBuilds.role: River lineage ferry healer who can guide an underwater rescue
npcBuilds.motive: Recover a missing ferry passenger before the current takes them past the landing.
npcBuilds.hook: Ilen can ask fish which side of the old pier the passenger surfaced on, then dress their wounds once the group gets them ashore.
